q.en: Where do 85–90 % of the descending corticospinal tract fibres cross the midline to form the lateral corticospinal tract?
q.uz: Tushuvchi kortikospinal yo'l tolalarining 85–90 % qismi lateral kortikospinal traktni hosil qilish uchun o'rta chiziqni qayerda kesib o'tadi?

options.en: At the pyramidal decussation in the caudal medulla (plate U1)
options.uz: Uzunchoq miya pastidagi piramidalar kesishmasida (U1 plastinkasi)

options.en: In the anterior white commissure at each spinal cord segment
options.uz: Orqa miyaning har bir segmentidagi old oq bitishmasida

options.en: Across the basis pontis via transverse pontocerebellar fibres (plate K2)
options.uz: Ko'prik asosida ko'ndalang ko'prik-miyacha tolalari orqali (K2 plastinkasi)

options.en: Within the internal capsule genu at the foramen of Monro (plate B5)
options.uz: Monro teshigi darajasida ichki kapsula tizzasida (B5 plastinkasi)

why.en: The corticospinal tract descends uncrossed through the internal capsule, crus cerebri, basis pontis, and medullary pyramid until the caudal medulla (medulla–cord junction, plate U1), where 85–90 % of fibres cross in the pyramidal (motor) decussation into the opposite lateral funiculus.
why.uz: Kortikospinal yo'l ichki kapsula, miya oyoqchasi, ko'prik asosi va uzunchoq miya piramidasidan o'z tomonida tushib, uzunchoq miyaning pastki qismida (orqa miya chegarasi, U1 plastinkasi) piramidalar harakat kesishmasida 85–90 % tolasi qarama-qarshi lateral tizimchaga o'tadi.

q.en: Which sensory modalities are carried by the dorsal column–medial lemniscus (DCML) pathway?
q.uz: Orqa ustun – medial lemnisk (DCML) yo'li qaysi sezgi turlarini o'tkazadi?

options.en: Discriminative touch, vibration, and conscious joint position sense
options.uz: Nozik farqlovchi teginish, tebranish va ongli bo'g'im holati sezgisi

options.en: Nociceptive pain, thermal sensation, and poorly localized crude touch
options.uz: Og'riq, harorat o'zgarishi va aniq chegaralanmagan dag'al teginish

options.en: Unconscious muscle-spindle proprioception ascending to the cerebellum
options.uz: Miyacha chuvalchangiga ko'tariluvchi ongsiz mushak proprioretsepsiyasi

options.en: Gustatory taste and visceral sensation from the anterior tongue mucosa
options.uz: Tilning oldingi uchdan ikki qismidan keluvchi ta'm va visseral sezgi

why.en: Large myelinated Aβ fibres of the dorsal column–medial lemniscus pathway carry fine discriminative (two-point) touch, vibration, and conscious joint position sense (proprioception) from the body to the VPL thalamus and primary somatosensory cortex (S1).
why.uz: Orqa ustun – medial lemnisk (DCML) yo'lining yo'g'on miyelinli Aβ tolalari nozik farqlovchi teginish, tebranish (vibratsiya) va ongli bo'g'im-mushak holati sezgisini (proprioretsepsiyani) talamusning VPL yadrosi orqali birlamchi somatosensor po'stloqqa (S1) olib boradi.

q.en: How are fasciculus gracilis and fasciculus cuneatus arranged from medial to lateral in the cervical dorsal column, and which body regions do they represent?
q.uz: Bo'yin orqa ustunida nozik tutam (fasciculus gracilis) va ponasimon tutam (fasciculus cuneatus) medialdan lateralga qanday joylashgan va tananing qaysi qismlaridan signal olib keladi?

options.en: Gracilis sits medially (legs and lower trunk below T6); cuneatus sits laterally (arms and upper trunk from T6 up)
options.uz: Nozik tutam medialda (T6 dan pastki tana va oyoqlar); ponasimon tutam lateralda (T6 dan yuqori tana va qo'llar)

options.en: Gracilis sits laterally (arms and upper trunk from T6 up); cuneatus sits medially (legs and lower trunk below T6)
options.uz: Nozik tutam lateralda (T6 dan yuqori tana va qo'llar); ponasimon tutam medialda (T6 dan pastki tana va oyoqlar)

options.en: Gracilis sits medially (bilateral visceral afferents); cuneatus sits laterally (contralateral pain and temperature)
options.uz: Nozik tutam medialda (ikki tomonlama visseral sezgi); ponasimon tutam lateralda (qarama-qarshi og'riq va harorat)

options.en: Gracilis sits dorsally (sacral descending motor axons); cuneatus sits ventrally (cervical tactile afferents)
options.uz: Nozik tutam dorsalda (dumg'aza harakat tolalari); ponasimon tutam ventralda (bo'yin segmentlari teginish tolalari)

why.en: First-order dorsal column axons ascend ipsilaterally: fibres from the leg and lower trunk (below T6) enter first and sit medially as the fasciculus gracilis, while fibres from the upper trunk and arm (T6 and above) are added laterally as the fasciculus cuneatus.
why.uz: Birinchi neyron aksonlari orqa miyada o'z tomonida kesishmasdan ko'tariladi: oyoq va pastki tanadan (T6 dan pastdan) keluvchi tolalar medialda nozik tutamni, T6 va undan yuqorida qo'shiladigan qo'l hamda yuqori tana tolalari esa lateralda ponasimon tutamni hosil qiladi.

q.en: Where does the dorsal column–medial lemniscus (DCML) pathway cross the midline, and which neuron's axons perform this crossing?
q.uz: Orqa ustun – medial lemnisk (DCML) yo'li o'rta chiziqni qayerda kesib o'tadi va bu kesishmani nechanchi neyron aksonlari hosil qiladi?

options.en: Caudal medulla (plate U2), where second-order axons cross as internal arcuate fibres
options.uz: Kaudal medullada (U2), ikkinchi neyronlar ichki yoysimon tolalar bo'lib

options.en: Spinal cord dorsal horn, where first-order axons cross the anterior white commissure
options.uz: Orqa miya orqa shoxida, birinchi neyron aksonlari old oq bitishma orqali kesishib

options.en: Caudal midbrain tegmentum (plate O1), where second-order axons cross in the SCP decussation
options.uz: Kaudal o'rta miya tegmentumida (O1), ikkinchi neyron tolalari SCP kesishmasida

options.en: Caudal pons (plate K1), where third-order axons cross midline within the trapezoid body
options.uz: Kaudal ko'prikda (K1), uchinchi neyron aksonlari trapetsiyasimon tana ichida

why.en: First-order dorsal column axons ascend uncrossed to the caudal medulla (plate U2, just above the pyramidal decussation) and synapse on second-order neurons in the nucleus gracilis and nucleus cuneatus. Their axons sweep ventromedially as the internal arcuate fibres, cross the midline in the sensory decussation, and ascend as the contralateral medial lemniscus.
why.uz: Birinchi neyron aksonlari kesishmasdan uzunchoq miya pastigacha (U2 plastinkasi, piramidalar kesishmasidan sal yuqoriga) chiqib, nozik va ponasimon yadrolardagi ikkinchi neyronda tugaydi. Ikkinchi neyron aksonlari ichki yoysimon tolalar bo'lib o'rta chiziqni kesib o'tadi (sezgi kesishmasi) va qarama-qarshi tomonda medial lemnisk bo'lib ko'tariladi.

q.en: Which sensory modalities are carried by the anterolateral system (spinothalamic tract, ALS), and where do its fibres cross the midline?
q.uz: Anterolateral tizim (spinotalamik yo'l, ALS) qaysi sezgi turlarini tashiydi va uning tolalari o'rta chiziqni qayerda kesib o'tadi?

options.en: Pain, temperature, and crude touch; second-order axons cross in the spinal anterior white commissure
options.uz: Og'riq, harorat va dag'al teginish; ikkinchi neyron aksonlari orqa miya old oq bitishmasida kesishadi

options.en: Vibration and joint position sense; second-order axons cross in the caudal medulla as arcuate fibres
options.uz: Tebranish va bo'g'im holati sezgisi; ikkinchi neyron aksonlari uzunchoq miyada yoysimon tolalar bo'lib kesishadi

options.en: Facial pain and thermal sensation; second-order axons cross in the caudal pons via the trapezoid body
options.uz: Yuz og'rig'i va harorat sezgisi; ikkinchi neyron tolalari kaudal ko'prikda trapetsiyasimon tanada kesishadi

options.en: Unconscious limb proprioception; second-order axons cross twice to reach the ipsilateral cerebellum
options.uz: Ongsiz oyoq-qo'l proprioretsepsiyasi; ikkinchi neyron tolalari miyachaga borishda ikki marta kesishadi

why.en: Thin Aδ and C primary afferents for pain, temperature, and crude touch synapse in the dorsal horn (laminae I, II, V); the second-order neuron's axon crosses within 1–2 spinal segments through the anterior white commissure and ascends in the contralateral anterolateral column and lateral brainstem to VPL thalamus.
why.uz: Birinchi neyronning ingichka Aδ va C tolalari orqa miya orqa shoxida (I, II, V plastinkalar) tugaydi; ikkinchi neyron aksoni kirgan joyidan 1–2 segment ichida old oq bitishmada qarama-qarshi tomonga kesishib, anterolateral ustun va miya ustunining lateral qismi bo'ylab VPL talamusga ko'tariladi.

q.en: Which pathway carries pain and temperature sensation from the face, and what unusual route do its primary afferent fibres take after entering the lateral pons?
q.uz: Yuzning og'riq va harorat sezgisini qaysi yo'l olib boradi va uning birinchi neyron tolalari ko'prikning lateral qismiga kirgach qanday o'ziga xos yo'nalishda harakatlanadi?

options.en: Trigeminothalamic pathway: afferents descend in the spinal trigeminal tract to the caudal medulla before synapsing and crossing to VPM
options.uz: Trigeminotalamik yo'l: tolalar spinal trigeminal traktda kaudal medullaga tushib, sinapsdan keyin VPM ga kesishadi

options.en: Dorsal column–medial lemniscus: afferents ascend ipsilaterally in the fasciculus cuneatus to the cuneate nucleus before crossing to VPL
options.uz: Orqa ustun – medial lemnisk: tolalar ponasimon tutam bo'ylab o'z tomonida ko'tarilib, ponasimon yadrodan VPL ga kesishadi

options.en: Ventral spinothalamic pathway: afferents synapse immediately in the mid-pontine principal nucleus and ascend uncrossed to the VPM thalamus
options.uz: Ventral spinotalamik yo'l: tolalar o'rta ko'prikdagi asosiy yadroda darhol tugab, kesishmasdan VPM talamusga ko'tariladi

options.en: Solitariothalamic pathway: afferents descend through the solitary tract to the caudal medulla before ascending bilaterally to the VPM thalamus
options.uz: Solitariotalamik yo'l: tolalar yolg'iz yo'l trakti bo'ylab kaudal medullaga tushib, ikki tomonlama VPM talamusga chiqadi

why.en: First-order neurons in the trigeminal (Gasserian) ganglion enter the lateral mid-pons (plate K2). While discriminative touch fibres synapse at once in the principal sensory nucleus, pain and temperature fibres turn caudally in the spinal trigeminal tract down to the caudal medulla and upper cervical cord (spinal trigeminal nucleus pars caudalis, plates U3–U1), synapse, cross the midline, and ascend as the ventral trigeminothalamic tract to VPM thalamus.
why.uz: Uch shoxli nerv (Gasser) tugunidagi birinchi neyron tolalari o'rta ko'prikning yon qismidan (K2 plastinkasi) kiradi: teginish tolalari shu yerda asosiy sezuvchi yadroda tugasa, yuzning og'riq va harorat tolalari spinal trigeminal trakt bo'ylab uzunchoq miya pastigacha (U3–U1) pastga tushadi, spinal trigeminal yadroning kaudal qismida ikkinchi neyronga uzatilib o'rta chiziqni kesadi va qarama-qarshi VPM talamusga ko'tariladi.

q.en: How is the body (homunculus) mapped along the primary motor cortex (precentral gyrus, BA4) and primary somatosensory cortex (postcentral gyrus, BA3, 1, 2), and which cerebral arteries supply each part?
q.uz: Birlamchi harakat (oldingi markaziy pushta, BA4) va birlamchi somatosensor (orqa markaziy pushta, BA3, 1, 2) po'stlog'ida tana xaritasi (gomunkulus) qanday joylashgan va uning qismlarini qaysi arteriyalar qon bilan ta'minlaydi?

options.en: Leg and foot sit medially (ACA territory); trunk, arm, hand, and face lie on the lateral convexity (MCA territory)
options.uz: Oyoq va tovon medial yuzada (ACA havzasi); tana, qo'l, kaft va yuz lateral qavariq yuzada (MCA havzasi)

options.en: Face and hand sit medially (ACA territory); trunk, leg, and foot lie along the inferior lateral fissure (MCA territory)
options.uz: Yuz va kaft medial yuzada (ACA havzasi); tana, oyoq va tovon pastki lateral egat bo'ylab (MCA havzasi)

options.en: Leg and trunk sit in the occipital pole (PCA territory); arm and face lie on the medial paracentral lobule (ACA territory)
options.uz: Oyoq va tana ensa qutbida (PCA havzasi); qo'l va yuz medial paratsentral bo'lakchada (ACA havzasi)

options.en: Ipsilateral leg sits medially (MCA territory); ipsilateral arm and face lie along the superior temporal gyrus (PCA territory)
options.uz: O'sha tomon oyog'i medialda (MCA havzasi); o'sha tomon qo'li va yuzi yuqori chakka pushtasida (PCA havzasi)

why.en: Along both the precentral (M1) and postcentral (S1) gyri, the contralateral body is mapped upside down: the foot and leg hang over into the medial paracentral lobule (ACA territory — an ACA stroke causes contralateral leg-predominant weakness and sensory loss), while the arm, hand (the precentral omega knob, Yousry 1997), and face lie on the lateral convexity (MCA territory).
why.uz: Oldingi (M1) va orqa (S1) markaziy pushtalarda qarama-qarshi tana teskari tartibda joylashgan: oyoq medial yuzada (ACA havzasi — ACA insultida qarama-qarshi oyoq falajlanadi), qo'l, kaft (oldingi markaziy pushtadagi teskari omega bo'rtig'i — Yousry 1997) va yuz esa lateral qavariq yuzada (MCA havzasi — MCA insultida yuz va qo'l zaiflashadi).

sources.title: Yousry et al. 1997, Brain — Localization of the motor hand area to a knob on the precentral gyrus. A new landmark

q.en: Which clinical signs distinguish an upper motor neuron (UMN, corticospinal) lesion from a lower motor neuron (LMN, anterior horn or ventral root) lesion?
q.uz: Yuqori motoneyron (kortikospinal yo'l) zararlanishini pastki motoneyron (orqa miya oldingi shoxi yoki old ildiz) zararlanishidan qaysi klinik belgilar ajratib turadi?

options.en: UMN: spasticity, hyperreflexia, and Babinski sign; LMN: flaccidity, areflexia, marked atrophy, and fasciculations
options.uz: Yuqori motoneyron: spastiklik, giperrefleksiya va Babinski belgisi; pastki: sust falaj, arefleksiya, atrofiya va fassikulyatsiya

options.en: UMN: flaccid paralysis, areflexia, and fasciculations; LMN: spasticity, brisk reflexes, and extensor plantar sign
options.uz: Yuqori motoneyron: sust falaj, arefleksiya va fassikulyatsiya; pastki: spastiklik, giperrefleksiya va Babinski belgisi

options.en: UMN: cogwheel rigidity, bradykinesia, and resting tremor; LMN: intention tremor, dysmetria, and hypotonic gait
options.uz: Yuqori motoneyron: tishli g'ildirak rigidligi, bradikineziya va tinch tremor; pastki: intension tremor, dismetriya va gipotoniya

options.en: UMN: distal stocking-glove sensory loss with normal tone; LMN: pure proximal weakness with hyperactive reflexes
options.uz: Yuqori motoneyron: normal tonusda distal sezgi yo'qolishi; pastki: oshgan reflekslar bilan sof proksimal mushak zaifligi

why.en: Damage to the first neuron (UMN: M1 → internal capsule → brainstem → lateral CST) releases spinal stretch reflexes, producing spastic tone, brisk tendon reflexes, a Babinski sign, and minimal early atrophy. Damage to the second neuron (LMN: anterior horn α-motor neuron or cranial motor nucleus/nerve) denervates muscle directly, causing flaccid weakness, lost reflexes, rapid atrophy, and fasciculations.
why.uz: Birinchi neyron (yuqori motoneyron: po'stloqdan lateral CST gacha) zararlansa spastiklik, pay reflekslarining oshishi, musbat Babinski belgisi va kam atrofiya kuzatiladi; ikkinchi neyron (pastki motoneyron: oldingi shox yoki kalla nervi harakat yadrosi/tolasi) zararlansa sust (flaksid) falaj, arefleksiya, yaqqol mushak atrofiyasi va fassikulyatsiyalar paydo bo'ladi.

q.en: Regarding the corticospinal tract, why does a unilateral lesion in the cerebral hemisphere or brainstem paralyse the contralateral side of the body, whereas a unilateral lesion in the cervical or thoracic spinal cord paralyses the ipsilateral side?
q.uz: Nima uchun yarim sharlarda yoki miya ustunidagi bir tomonlama o'choq tananing qarama-qarshi tomonini falaj qiladi, orqa miyadagi bir tomonlama o'choq esa o'sha tomonni falaj qiladi?

options.en: Corticospinal fibres decussate in the caudal medulla (plate U1), so lesions above U1 are contralateral and lesions below U1 are ipsilateral
options.uz: Kortikospinal tolalar kaudal medullada (U1) kesishadi: U1 dan yuqori o'choq qarama-qarshi, pastki o'choq o'sha tomonni falajlaydi

options.en: Corticospinal fibres cross in the basis pontis and then recross at the cervicomedullary junction before entering the anterior horn
options.uz: Kortikospinal tolalar ko'prik asosida kesishib, so'ngra bo'yin-medulla chegarasida yana o'z tomoniga qaytib o'tadi

options.en: Spinal anterior horn motor neurons send axons across the anterior white commissure to exit through the contralateral ventral root
options.uz: Orqa miya oldingi shox motoneyronlari old oq bitishmadan kesib o'tib, qarama-qarshi old ildiz orqali mushakka chiqadi

options.en: Corticospinal fibres descend uncrossed through the brainstem and cross segmentally inside the ipsilateral dorsal root ganglion
options.uz: Kortikospinal tolalar miya ustunidan kesishmay tushib, har bir segmentda orqa ildiz tuguni ichida kesishadi

why.en: From M1 through the internal capsule, crus cerebri, basis pontis, and medullary pyramid, the corticospinal fibres travel on the side of their hemisphere of origin, so a lesion above the pyramidal decussation weakens the contralateral body. At the medulla–cord junction (plate U1) they decussate into the opposite lateral funiculus, so any spinal cord lesion below U1 weakens the ipsilateral body.
why.uz: Harakat po'stlog'idan (M1) ichki kapsula, miya oyoqchasi, ko'prik asosi va uzunchoq miya piramidasigacha tolalar o'z yarim shari tomonida tushadi va U1 darajasida (piramidalar kesishmasi) qarama-qarshi tomonga o'tadi. Shuning uchun kesishmadan yuqoridagi o'choq qarama-qarshi tomonni, orqa miyadagi o'choq esa o'sha tomonni falaj qiladi.

q.en: How do you clinically distinguish a central (supranuclear, corticobulbar) facial palsy from a peripheral (CN VII nucleus or nerve root) facial palsy?
q.uz: Yuzning markaziy (kortikobulbar) falajini periferik (VII nerv yadrosi yoki ildizi) falajidan klinik ko'rikda qanday farqlash mumkin?

options.en: Central: weakens only the contralateral lower face (sparing the forehead); peripheral: paralyses the entire ipsilateral hemiface
options.uz: Markaziy: qarama-qarshi yuzning faqat pastki yarmi zaiflashadi (peshona saqlanadi); periferik: o'sha tomon yuzi to'liq falajlanadi

options.en: Central: weakens only the contralateral forehead (sparing the mouth); peripheral: paralyses the lower half of both sides of the face
options.uz: Markaziy: qarama-qarshi peshona zaiflashib og'iz saqlanadi; periferik: yuzning ikkala tomonida faqat pastki qism falajlanadi

options.en: Central: weakens the entire ipsilateral hemiface including the forehead; peripheral: weakens only the contralateral perioral muscles
options.uz: Markaziy: o'sha tomonda peshona bilan butun yuz falajlanadi; periferik: faqat qarama-qarshi og'iz atrofi mushaklari zaiflashadi

options.en: Central: impairs facial pain sensation with preserved facial movement; peripheral: causes bilateral ptosis with preserved eye closure
options.uz: Markaziy: yuz harakati saqlanib og'riq sezgisi yo'qoladi; periferik: ko'z yumilishi saqlanib ikki tomonlama ptoz yuz beradi

why.en: In the facial motor nucleus (plate K1), neurons supplying the upper face (frontalis, orbicularis oculi) receive bilateral corticobulbar input, whereas neurons supplying the lower face receive only contralateral input. Therefore, a supranuclear lesion (motor cortex, internal capsule genu, or crus cerebri) weakens only the contralateral lower face, whereas a nuclear or infranuclear CN VII lesion paralyses the entire ipsilateral hemiface including the forehead.
why.uz: Yuz nervi harakat yadrosining (K1 plastinkasi) peshona va ko'z atrofini boshqaruvchi yuqori qismi ikkala yarim shardan, og'iz atrofini boshqaruvchi pastki qismi esa faqat qarama-qarshi yarim shardan kortikobulbar tola oladi. Shu bois markaziy (po'stloq, ichki kapsula, oyoqcha) o'choqda qarama-qarshi yuzning faqat pastki qismi, yadro yoki ildiz (CN VII) o'chog'ida esa o'sha tomonda butun yuz (peshona ham) falajlanadi.

q.en: Why does a lateral medullary (Wallenberg) infarct (plate U3) produce crossed pain and temperature loss — ipsilateral on the face and contralateral on the body — while sparing fine touch, vibration, and joint position sense?
q.uz: Nima sababdan lateral uzunchoq miya (Wallenberg) infarkti (U3 plastinkasi) og'riq va harorat sezgisini yuzda o'sha tomonda, tanada esa qarama-qarshi tomonda yo'qotadi (kesishgan sezgi buzilishi), biroq nozik teginish, tebranish va holat sezgisini saqlab qoladi?

options.en: Lateral medulla holds uncrossed spinal trigeminal and crossed spinothalamic tracts; the medial lemniscus lies medially in ASA territory
options.uz: Lateral medullada kesishmagan spinal trigeminal va kesishgan spinotalamik trakt yotadi; medial lemnisk esa medialda saqlanadi

options.en: Lateral medulla holds crossed medial lemniscus and uncrossed corticospinal tracts; pain fibres lie paramedially near the hypoglossal root
options.uz: Lateral medullada kesishgan medial lemnisk va kortikospinal trakt yotadi; og'riq tolalari esa til osti ildizi yonida o'tadi

options.en: PICA occlusion destroys the contralateral VPL and ipsilateral VPM nuclei while sparing dorsal column fibres entering the cuneate nucleus
options.uz: PICA tiqilishi qarama-qarshi VPL va o'sha tomon VPM yadrolarini zararlab, ponasimon yadroga kiruvchi tolalarni saqlab qoladi

options.en: Lateral medulla contains uncrossed spinothalamic and crossed trigeminothalamic tracts; touch fibres ascend dorsally in the solitary tract
options.uz: Lateral medullada kesishmagan spinotalamik va kesishgan trigeminotalamik trakt yotadi; teginish esa yolg'iz yo'lda ko'tariladi

why.en: On plate U3 (mid-olivary open medulla), the lateral wedge supplied by PICA and vertebral artery branches contains both the descending uncrossed spinal trigeminal tract and nucleus (carrying pain and temperature from the ipsilateral face) and the ascending already-crossed spinothalamic tract (carrying pain and temperature from the contralateral body). The medial lemniscus and pyramid lie paramedially in the anterior spinal artery (ASA) territory and are spared.
why.uz: U3 plastinkasida PICA ta'minlaydigan lateral sohada ikki og'riq yo'li yonma-yon joylashgan: hali kesishmagan tushuvchi spinal trigeminal trakt va yadro (o'sha tomon yuzi) hamda orqa miyada allaqachon kesishgan ko'tariluvchi spinotalamik trakt (qarama-qarshi tana). Medial lemnisk va piramida esa oldingi orqa miya arteriyasi (ASA) havzasidagi paramedian sohada bo'lgani uchun zararlanmaydi.

q.en: How are descending cortical fibres arranged from medial to lateral across the crus cerebri of the midbrain (plate O2), and how are the somatotopic fibres within its middle three-fifths ordered?
q.uz: O'rta miya oyoqchasida (crus cerebri, O2 plastinkasi) tushuvchi po'stloq tolalari medialdan lateralga qanday tartibda joylashgan va uning o'rta beshdan uch qismidagi harakat tolalari somatotopiyasi qanday?

options.en: Medial fifth: frontopontine; middle three-fifths: corticobulbar and corticospinal (face → arm → leg); lateral fifth: parieto-temporo-occipito-pontine
options.uz: Medial 1/5: frontopontin; o'rta 3/5: kortikobulbar va kortikospinal (yuz → qo'l → oyoq); lateral 1/5: parieto-temporo-oksipito-pontin

options.en: Medial fifth: parieto-temporo-occipito-pontine; middle three-fifths: corticospinal (leg → arm → face); lateral fifth: frontopontine and nigrostriatal
options.uz: Medial 1/5: parieto-temporo-oksipito-pontin; o'rta 3/5: kortikospinal (oyoq → qo'l → yuz); lateral 1/5: frontopontin va nigrostriatal

options.en: Medial fifth: corticobulbar fibres; middle three-fifths: ascending medial lemniscus and spinothalamic tract; lateral fifth: rubrospinal and tectospinal
options.uz: Medial 1/5: kortikobulbar tolalar; o'rta 3/5: ko'tariluvchi medial lemnisk va spinotalamik trakt; lateral 1/5: rubrospinal va tektospinal

options.en: Medial fifth: dentato-rubro-thalamic outflow; middle three-fifths: transverse pontocerebellar fibres; lateral fifth: descending corticospinal fibres
options.uz: Medial 1/5: dentato-rubro-talamik chiqish; o'rta 3/5: ko'ndalang ko'prik-miyacha tolalari; lateral 1/5: tushuvchi kortikospinal tolalar

why.en: In the crus cerebri (plates O1–O3), the medial fifth carries frontopontine fibres, the lateral fifth carries parieto-temporo-occipito-pontine fibres, and the middle three-fifths carry corticobulbar and corticospinal fibres arranged somatotopically with face most medial, then arm, trunk, and leg lateral.
why.uz: O1–O3 plastinkalarida miya oyoqchasi (crus cerebri) uch qismga bo'lingan: medial 1/5 — peshona-ko'prik (frontopontin), lateral 1/5 — tepa-chakka-ensa-ko'prik (parieto-temporo-oksipito-pontin) va o'rta 3/5 — kortikobulbar hamda kortikospinal tolalar bo'lib, ularda yuz medialda, qo'l o'rtada va oyoq lateralda joylashgan.

q.en: How do the orientation and position of the medial lemniscus change as it ascends from the open medulla (plate U3) through the pons (plates K1–K3) into the midbrain (plate O2)?
q.uz: Medial lemnisk ochiq uzunchoq miyadan (U3 plastinkasi) ko'prik (K1–K3) orqali o'rta miyaga (O2) ko'tarilar ekan, uning joylashuvi va holati qanday o'zgaradi?

options.en: Vertical paramedian ribbon in medulla, horizontal at the pontine tegmentum–basis border, then dorsolateral to the red nucleus in midbrain
options.uz: Medullada piramida ustida tik tasma, ko'prikda tegmentum–asos chegarasida yotiq lenta, o'rta miyada esa qizil yadrodan dorsolateralda

options.en: Horizontal band ventral to the medullary pyramid, vertical in the midline pontine raphe, then ventral inside the crus cerebri in midbrain
options.uz: Medullada piramida ostida yotiq tasma, ko'prikda o'rta chiziq rafesida tik lenta, o'rta miyada esa miya oyoqchasining ventral qismida

options.en: Dorsolateral to the inferior olive in medulla, traversing the middle cerebellar peduncle in pons, then medial to the aqueduct in midbrain
options.uz: Medullada pastki zaytundan dorsolateralda, ko'prikda o'rta miyacha oyoqchasida, o'rta miyada esa Silviy suv yo'lidan medialda joylashadi

options.en: Paramedian in the fourth-ventricle floor throughout medulla and pons, then decussating dorsal to the cerebral aqueduct in the midbrain
options.uz: Medulla va ko'prikda IV qorincha tubida paramedian o'tadi, so'ngra o'rta miyada Silviy suv yo'lining dorsal tomonida qarama-qarshi kesishadi

why.en: In the open medulla (plate U3), the medial lemniscus stands as a vertical paramedian ribbon between the pyramid and MLF (leg ventral, neck dorsal). In the pons (plates K1–K2) it rotates 90° to lie horizontally along the ventral border of the tegmentum (leg lateral, traversed by the trapezoid body in K1). In the midbrain (plates O1–O2) it shifts dorsolaterally, lateral to the red nucleus, joining the spinothalamic and trigeminothalamic tracts on the way to VPL thalamus.
why.uz: Ochiq uzunchoq miyada (U3) medial lemnisk piramida va MLF orasida tik turgan vertikal tasma ko'rinishida (oyoq ventralda); ko'prikda (K1–K2) 90° burilib tegmentum va asos chegarasida gorizontal yotib oladi (oyoq lateralda, K1 da trapetsiyasimon tana kesib o'tadi); o'rta miyada (O1–O2) esa qizil yadrodan dorsolateralga surilib, spinotalamik tolalar bilan yonma-yon VPL talamusga boradi.

q.en: Why does an expanding central-canal lesion in the cervical spinal cord (syringomyelia) cause a bilateral cape-like loss of pain and temperature over the shoulders and arms while preserving fine touch, vibration, and joint position sense?
q.uz: Nima sababdan bo'yin orqa miyasida markaziy kanalning kengayishi (siringomieliya) yelka va qo'llarda pelerin shaklida ikki tomonlama og'riq va harorat sezgisini yo'qotib, teginish, tebranish va holat sezgisini saqlab qoladi?

options.en: The syrinx cuts crossing spinothalamic axons in the anterior white commissure while sparing the posterior dorsal columns
options.uz: Kengaygan bo'shliq old oq bitishmada kesishuvchi spinotalamik tolalarni uzadi, orqadagi orqa ustunlar esa saqlanib qoladi

options.en: The syrinx compresses the paired posterior spinal arteries while sparing the unpaired anterior spinal artery ventrally
options.uz: Kengaygan bo'shliq juft orqa spinal arteriyalarni qisib qo'yadi, ventraldagi oldingi spinal arteriya esa saqlanib qoladi

options.en: The syrinx selectively destroys the nucleus gracilis and cuneatus while sparing ascending lateral spinothalamic fibres
options.uz: Kengaygan bo'shliq nozik va ponasimon yadrolarni tanlab yemiradi, lateral spinotalamik tolalar esa zararlanmay qoladi

options.en: The syrinx interrupts uncrossed dorsal column afferents at entry while sparing first-order nociceptors in Lissauer's tract
options.uz: Kengaygan bo'shliq kirishdagi orqa ustun tolalarini uzadi, Lissauer traktidagi birinchi neyron og'riq tolalari esa saqlanadi

why.en: In the spinal cord, second-order spinothalamic axons cross the midline in the anterior white commissure immediately ventral to the central canal. A cervical syrinx stretches and cuts these crossing fibres segmentally on both sides — producing a suspended cape of bilateral pain and temperature loss over the shoulders and upper limbs (dissociated sensory loss) — while sparing the dorsal columns (fasciculus gracilis and cuneatus) posteriorly.
why.uz: Spinotalamik yo'lning ikkinchi neyron aksonlari markaziy kanalning bevosita oldidagi old oq bitishmada kesishadi. Siringomieliya markaziy kanalni kengaytirib, bir necha bo'yin segmentidagi kesishuvchi tolalarni ikki tomonda uzadi: yelka va qo'llarda pelerin shaklida og'riq va harorat sezgisi yo'qoladi (dissotsiatsiyalangan sezgi buzilishi), orqa ustunlardagi teginish va holat sezgisi esa saqlanib qoladi.

q.en: Why can a small focal lesion right at the pyramidal decussation (plate U1) or a foramen magnum meningioma produce cruciate hemiplegia (weakness of one arm and the opposite leg)?
q.uz: Nima uchun aynan piramidalar kesishmasidagi (U1 plastinkasi) kichik o'choq yoki katta teshik (foramen magnum) o'smasi xochsimon gemiplegiyani — bir tomondagi qo'l va qarama-qarshi tomondagi oyoq falajini berishi mumkin?

options.en: Arm corticospinal fibres cross rostral to leg fibres, so a focal lesion catches crossed arm fibres and uncrossed leg fibres together
options.uz: Qo'l kortikospinal tolalari oyoq tolalaridan yuqoriroqda kesishadi, shuning uchun o'choq kesishgan qo'l va kesishmagan oyoq tolalarini tutadi

options.en: Leg corticospinal fibres cross in the caudal pons while arm fibres remain uncrossed until the anterior white commissure of the cervical cord
options.uz: Oyoq kortikospinal tolalari kaudal ko'prikda kesishadi, qo'l tolalari esa bo'yin orqa miyasining old oq bitishmasigacha kesishmay tushadi

options.en: Arm motor commands descend through the crossed rubrospinal tract while leg motor commands descend in the uncrossed anterior corticospinal tract
options.uz: Qo'l harakat buyruqlari kesishgan rubrospinal trakt orqali, oyoq harakat buyruqlari esa kesishmagan oldingi kortikospinal trakt orqali tushadi

options.en: Arm fibres decussate twice in the lower brainstem while leg fibres cross once at the cervicomedullary junction into the dorsal funiculus
options.uz: Qo'l tolalari pastki miya ustunida ikki marta kesishadi, oyoq tolalari esa bo'yin-medulla chegarasida orqa tizimchaga bir marta kesishib o'tadi

why.en: Within the pyramidal decussation (plate U1), fibres destined for the cervical cord (arm) cross slightly rostral to those for the lumbosacral cord (leg). A small eccentric lesion at the decussation can hit the already-crossed ipsilateral arm fibres and the not-yet-crossed contralateral leg fibres simultaneously, producing cruciate hemiplegia.
why.uz: Piramidalar kesishmasida (U1 plastinkasi) bo'yin segmentlariga (qo'lga) boruvchi tolalar bel-dumg'aza (oyoq) tolalaridan biroz rostralroqda kesishadi; shuning uchun aynan kesishmadagi kichik o'choq allaqachon kesib o'tgan o'sha tomon qo'l tolalarini va hali kesishmagan qarama-qarshi oyoq tolalarini birga falajlashi (xochsimon gemiplegiya) mumkin.

q.en: How is the face mapped along the rostro-caudal length of the spinal trigeminal nucleus (Dejerine's onion-skin somatotopy), and what facial sensory deficit results from a low lesion at the C1–C2 / caudal medullary level?
q.uz: Spinal trigeminal yadro bo'ylab yuz sezgisi qanday piyoz po'sti (Dejerine) tartibida joylashgan va yadroning pastki (C1–C2 / kaudal medulla) qismidagi o'choq yuzning qayerida og'riq sezgisini saqlab qoladi?

options.en: Perioral region maps rostrally and outer face rings map caudally at C1–C2, so a low lesion spares pain sensation around the mouth and nose
options.uz: Og'iz va burun atrofi rostralda, yuzning tashqi halqalari esa C1–C2 da joylashgan; pastki o'choq og'iz va burun atrofini saqlab qoladi

options.en: Forehead and scalp map rostrally while the mouth and chin map caudally at C1–C2, so a low lesion spares pain sensation over the upper face
options.uz: Peshona va bosh terisi rostralda, og'iz va iyak esa C1–C2 da joylashgan; pastki o'choq peshona va yuqori yuz og'riq sezgisini saqlaydi

options.en: V1 ophthalmic fibres terminate rostrally, V2 maxillary in the middle, and V3 mandibular caudally, so a low lesion spares only the cornea
options.uz: V1 ko'z tolalari rostralda, V2 o'rtada va V3 pastki jag' tolalari kaudalda tugaydi; pastki o'choq faqat shox parda sezgisini saqlab qoladi

options.en: Contralateral face maps dorsally and ipsilateral face maps ventrally, so a low lesion spares discriminative touch across all three divisions
options.uz: Qarama-qarshi yuz dorsalda, o'sha tomon yuzi ventralda joylashgan; pastki o'choq uchala shoxda ham nozik teginish sezgisini saqlab qoladi

why.en: While peripheral V1/V2/V3 dermatomes run in horizontal divisions from the trigeminal ganglion, inside the spinal trigeminal nucleus (pars caudalis, plates U1–U3) the face is mapped in concentric onion-skin rings: the mouth and nose sit rostrally near the obex, and successively outer rings (forehead, jaw angle, preauricular border) extend caudally to C1–C2. Thus a low caudal lesion spares the perioral region.
why.uz: Periferik V1/V2/V3 dermatomlaridan farqli o'laroq, spinal trigeminal yadroda (kaudal qism, U1–U3 plastinkalari) yuz konsentrik piyoz po'sti halqalari shaklida xaritalangan: og'iz va burun atrofi rostralda (obeksga yaqin), yuzning tashqi chetlari esa kaudalda (C1–C2 da) joylashgan. Shu sababli pastdagi o'choq (masalan, C1–C2 siringobulbiyasi) og'iz va burun atrofida og'riq sezgisini saqlab qoladi.

q.en: A patient with vitamin B12 deficiency (or nitrous-oxide toxicity) develops paraesthesias, loss of vibration and position sense in both legs, sensory ataxia with a positive Romberg sign, and bilateral extensor plantar responses (Babinski) with brisk knee jerks. Which two spinal cord pathways are affected in subacute combined degeneration?
q.uz: B12 vitamini tanqisligi (yoki azot oksidi zaharlanishi) bo'lgan bemorda ikkala oyoqda tebranish va holat sezgisi yo'qolishi, Romberg sinovi musbat bo'lgan sezgi ataksiyasi hamda ikki tomonlama spastik zaiflik va musbat Babinski belgisi aniqlandi. Subakut qo'shma degeneratsiyada orqa miyaning qaysi ikki yo'li birgalikda zararlanadi?

options.en: Dorsal columns (fasciculus gracilis and cuneatus) and lateral corticospinal tracts
options.uz: Orqa ustunlar (nozik va ponasimon tutamlar) va lateral kortikospinal traktlar

options.en: Lateral spinothalamic tracts and segmental fibres of the anterior white commissure
options.uz: Lateral spinotalamik traktlar va old oq bitishmaning segmentar kesishma tolalari

options.en: Dorsal and ventral spinocerebellar tracts alongside the medial vestibulospinal tract
options.uz: Dorsal va ventral spinoserebellyar traktlar hamda medial vestibulospinal trakt

options.en: Anterior horn lower motor neurons together with the descending rubrospinal pathways
options.uz: Orqa miya oldingi shox motoneyronlari va tushuvchi rubrospinal harakat yo'llari

why.en: Subacute combined degeneration (vitamin B12 or copper deficiency, or N₂O inactivation of methionine synthase) demyelinates the heavily myelinated dorsal columns (fasciculus gracilis and cuneatus → loss of vibration/proprioception, sensory ataxia with positive Romberg) together with the lateral corticospinal tracts (UMN signs, spastic weakness, Babinski), while sparing the spinothalamic tract.
why.uz: B12 vitamini (yoki mis) tanqisligida orqa ustunlar (nozik va ponasimon tutamlar — tebranish va holat sezgisi yo'qolishi, ko'z yumilganda yiqilish bilan kechuvchi musbat Romberg sinovi) hamda lateral ustunlardagi kortikospinal yo'llar (piramidal spastiklik va Babinski belgisi) birgalikda demiyelinizatsiyaga uchraydi (subakut qo'shma degeneratsiya).

sources.title: StatPearls — Spinal Cord Subacute Combined Degeneration

q.en: How does the clinical presentation of a lesion restricted to the postcentral gyrus (primary somatosensory cortex, S1) differ from a subcortical thalamic VPL lesion?
q.uz: Orqa markaziy pushta (birlamchi somatosensor po'stloq — S1) zararlanishi talamusning VPL yadrosi zararlanishidan klinik jihatdan qanday farq qiladi?

options.en: S1 lesions relatively spare crude pain and touch but abolish cortical discriminative modalities (astereognosis, agraphaesthesia, extinction)
options.uz: S1 o'chog'ida dag'al og'riq va teginish deyarli saqlanib, farqlovchi po'stloq sezgilari (astereognoz, agrafesteziya, so'nish) yo'qoladi

options.en: S1 lesions cause dense bilateral loss of pain and temperature over the limbs while preserving two-point discrimination and stereognosis
options.uz: S1 o'chog'i ikki nuqtani farqlash va stereognozni saqlab qolgan holda oyoq-qo'llarda ikki tomonlama og'riq va haroratni yo'qotadi

options.en: S1 lesions produce severe contralateral spontaneous burning dysaesthesia (thalamic pain) with complete anaesthesia across all modalities
options.uz: S1 o'chog'i barcha sezgi turlarining to'liq yo'qolishi va qarama-qarshi tomonda kuchli o'z-o'zidan yonuvchi talamik og'riqni keltirib chiqaradi

options.en: S1 lesions abolish ipsilateral vibration and joint position sense in the face and hand while sparing contralateral tactile localization
options.uz: S1 o'chog'i qarama-qarshi teginish joyini aniqlashni saqlab, o'sha tomon yuz va qo'lida tebranish hamda holat sezgisini yo'qotadi

why.en: Primary pain, temperature, and crude touch reach consciousness subcortically and diffusely, so they are only mildly blunted by an S1 lesion. Instead, cortical sensory loss destroys synthetic discriminative modalities: two-point discrimination, stereognosis (identifying an object by touch, especially BA2), graphaesthesia (recognizing numbers traced on the palm), and double simultaneous stimulation (sensory extinction). By contrast, a VPL thalamic lesion impairs all contralateral primary sensory modalities and may cause Dejerine–Roussy pain.
why.uz: Birlamchi dag'al sezgilar (og'riq, harorat, oddiy teginish) po'stloqosti darajasida ham idrok etilgani uchun S1 po'stloq o'chog'ida ular faqat biroz susayadi; buning o'rniga murakkab farqlovchi po'stloq sezgilari yo'qoladi: astereognoz (paypaslab narsani tanimaslik), agrafesteziya (kaftga chizilgan raqamni bilmaslik), ikki nuqtani farqlay olmaslik va sezgi so'nishi. Talamusning VPL o'chog'i esa barcha birlamchi sezgilarni chuqur buzadi va talamik og'riq (Dejerine–Roussy) berishi mumkin.

q.en: Why does occlusion of the anterior spinal artery at the mid-thoracic spinal cord produce bilateral paralysis and loss of pain and temperature below the lesion while sparing vibration and joint position sense?
q.uz: Nima sababdan ko'krak orqa miyasida oldingi spinal arteriya tiqilishi zararlanish sathidan pastda ikki tomonlama falaj (paraplegiya) hamda og'riq va harorat sezgisi yo'qolishini berib, tebranish va bo'g'im holati sezgisini saqlab qoladi?

options.en: The unpaired anterior spinal artery supplies the anterior two-thirds (CST, ALS, ventral horns), while paired posterior arteries supply the dorsal columns
options.uz: Yagona oldingi spinal arteriya oldingi 2/3 qismni (CST, ALS, old shoxlar) ta'minlaydi; orqa ustunlar juft orqa spinal arteriyalardan qon oladi

options.en: The paired anterior spinal arteries supply only the dorsal horns and gracile tracts, while the radicular artery of Adamkiewicz supplies the anterior horns
options.uz: Juft oldingi spinal arteriyalar faqat orqa shox va nozik tutamni ta'minlaydi; oldingi shoxlar esa Adamkevich ildiz arteriyasidan qon oladi

options.en: Vibration and position sense bypass the thoracic spinal cord via the paravertebral sympathetic chain before re-entering at the lower cervical segments
options.uz: Tebranish va holat sezgisi ko'krak orqa miyasini chetlab paravertebral simpatik zanjir orqali ko'tariladi va pastki bo'yin segmentlariga kiradi

options.en: Dorsal column axons are unmyelinated C fibres with lower metabolic demand, making them selectively resistant to complete thoracic cord ischaemia
options.uz: Orqa ustun aksonlari moddalar almashinuvi past bo'lgan miyelinsiz C tolalar bo'lib, ko'krak orqa miyasining to'liq ishemiyasiga chidamli

why.en: The single midline anterior spinal artery supplies the ventral two-thirds of the spinal cord: the anterior horns (LMN weakness at the level), the lateral corticospinal tracts (bilateral spastic paraplegia or tetraplegia below), and the spinothalamic tracts (bilateral loss of pain and temperature below). The dorsal columns (fasciculus gracilis and cuneatus) are supplied by the paired posterior spinal arteries, so vibration and proprioception remain intact.
why.uz: Oldingi spinal arteriya o'rta chiziqda joylashgan bo'lib, orqa miyaning oldingi uchdan ikki qismini (oldingi shoxlar, lateral kortikospinal va spinotalamik traktlarni ikki tomonda) qon bilan ta'minlaydi. U tiqilganda sathdan pastda para- yoki tetraplegiya va og'riq/harorat yo'qolishi yuzaga keladi, juft orqa spinal arteriyalardan qon oluvchi orqa ustunlar (tebranish va holat sezgisi) esa saqlanadi.

sources.title: StatPearls — Anterior Cord Syndrome (Ventral Cord Syndrome)

q.en: How does the neospinothalamic component of the anterolateral system differ from the paleospinothalamic (spinoreticular and spinomesencephalic) component in its thalamic/cortical targets and clinical role in pain?
q.uz: Anterolateral og'riq tizimining neospinotalamik qismi paleospinotalamik (spinoretikulyar va spinomezensefalik) qismidan talamus/po'stloqdagi manzili va og'riqni idrok etishdagi vazifasi bo'yicha qanday farq qiladi?

options.en: Neospinothalamic projects to VPL → S1 for sharp, localized pain; paleospinothalamic projects to RF, PAG, and intralaminar thalamus → cingulate/insula for affective pain
options.uz: Neospinotalamik VPL → S1 orqali og'riq joyi va kuchini bildiradi; paleospinotalamik RF, PAG va intralaminar talamus → belbog'/orolcha orqali affektiv og'riqni beradi

options.en: Neospinothalamic projects to intralaminar thalamus → cingulate for dull aching pain; paleospinothalamic projects to VPL → S1 for sharp pinprick localization
options.uz: Neospinotalamik intralaminar talamus → belbog' orqali simillovchi og'riqni beradi; paleospinotalamik VPL → S1 orqali o'tkir sanchuvchi og'riq joyini aniqlaydi

options.en: Neospinothalamic projects uncrossed to the cerebellar vermis for reflex withdrawal; paleospinothalamic projects via the medial lemniscus to VPM for facial pain
options.uz: Neospinotalamik kesishmasdan miyacha chuvalchangiga himoya refleksi uchun boradi; paleospinotalamik medial lemnisk orqali VPM ga yuz og'rig'ini olib chiqadi

options.en: Neospinothalamic projects to the ventral anterior thalamus → premotor cortex for motor tone; paleospinothalamic projects to the pulvinar → visual cortex for arousal
options.uz: Neospinotalamik ventral oldingi talamus → premotor po'stloqqa mushak tonusi uchun boradi; paleospinotalamik pulvinar → ko'rish po'stlog'iga uyg'oqlik beradi

why.en: Only the lateral neospinothalamic tract projects directly to VPL → S1 to encode the sensory-discriminative aspects of pain (exact location and intensity). Parallel paleospinothalamic, spinoreticular (to brainstem reticular formation for arousal), and spinomesencephalic (to PAG for descending pain modulation) fibres relay in the intralaminar (CM/Pf) and medial thalamus to the anterior cingulate cortex and anterior insula — mediating the slow, burning affective-motivational suffering of pain.
why.uz: Neospinotalamik yo'l to'g'ridan-to'g'ri VPL → S1 ga borib og'riqning qayerda va qanchalik kuchli ekanini bildiradi; parallel paleospinotalamik, spinoretikulyar (miya ustuni retikulyar formatsiyasiga — uyg'oqlik) va spinomezensefalik (PAG ga — tushuvchi og'riq nazorati) tolalar esa intralaminar (CM, Pf) va medial talamus orqali oldingi belbog' pushtasi hamda orolchaga (insula) borib, og'riqning affektiv, azobli tomonini shakllantiradi.

q.en: A 29-year-old man sustains a penetrating stab wound to the right half of the cervical spinal cord at C6 (right spinal hemisection, Brown-Séquard syndrome). Below C7–T1, what is the exact lateralization of his motor, dorsal-column, and spinothalamic deficits?
q.uz: 29 yoshli bemor bo'yin orqa miyasining C6 segmenti o'ng yarmidan pichoq jarohati oldi (orqa miyaning o'ng yarim kesilishi — Brown-Séquard sindromi). Jarohat sathidan (C7–T1 dan) pastda harakat, orqa ustun va spinotalamik sezgi yo'qolishlari tananing qaysi tomonida namoyon bo'ladi?

options.en: Right (ipsilateral) spastic hemiparesis and vibration/position loss, with left (contralateral) pain and temperature loss starting 1–2 segments below
options.uz: O'ng (o'sha) tomonda spastik gemiparez va tebranish/holat yo'qolishi; chap (qarama-qarshi) tomonda 1–2 segment pastdan og'riq va harorat yo'qolishi

options.en: Left (contralateral) spastic hemiparesis and vibration/position loss, with right (ipsilateral) pain and temperature loss starting 1–2 segments below
options.uz: Chap (qarama-qarshi) tomonda spastik gemiparez va tebranish/holat yo'qolishi; o'ng (o'sha) tomonda 1–2 segment pastdan og'riq va harorat yo'qolishi

options.en: Right (ipsilateral) spastic hemiparesis with bilateral cape-like pain and temperature loss, while vibration and joint position sense remain intact
options.uz: O'ng (o'sha) tomonda spastik gemiparez va ikki tomonlama pelerin shaklida og'riq/harorat yo'qolishi; tebranish va bo'g'im holati sezgisi saqlangan

options.en: Right (ipsilateral) loss of all motor, vibration, position, pain, and temperature modalities below C6, with completely preserved left-sided function
options.uz: C6 dan pastda faqat o'ng tomonda barcha harakat, tebranish, holat, og'riq va harorat sezgilarining yo'qolishi; chap tomon esa mutlaqo normal

why.en: A right C6 spinal hemisection (Brown-Séquard syndrome) cuts: (1) the right lateral CST (which already crossed at plate U1 → ipsilateral right UMN weakness below), (2) the right dorsal columns (which have not yet crossed → ipsilateral right loss of vibration, fine touch, and position sense below), and (3) the right spinothalamic tract (which already crossed 1–2 segments above its entry from the left body → contralateral left loss of pain and temperature starting 1–2 segments below), plus ipsilateral C6 segmental LMN signs and anaesthesia.
why.uz: O'ng C6 bo'yin orqa miyasi yarim kesilganda (Brown-Séquard sindromi): (1) U1 da allaqachon kesishgan o'ng lateral CST uzilib, o'ng oyoq-qo'lda markaziy falaj beradi; (2) hali kesishmagan o'ng orqa ustunlar uzilib, o'ng tomonda tebranish va holat sezgisini yo'qotadi; (3) chap tanadan kirib allaqachon o'ng tomonga kesishib o'tgan spinotalamik trakt uzilib, chap tomonda 1–2 segment pastdan og'riq va harorat sezgisini yo'qotadi (hamda C6 darajasida o'ng segmentar LMN belgilari bo'ladi).

q.en: A patient has left-body loss of pain and temperature, right-face loss of pain and temperature, and completely preserved motor strength and vibration/position sense, accompanied by right Horner syndrome, hoarseness and dysphagia (absent right gag reflex), vertigo/nystagmus, and right limb ataxia. Where is the lesion?
q.uz: Bemorda tananing chap yarmida og'riq va harorat sezgisi yo'qolgan, yuzning o'ng yarmida og'riq va harorat sezgisi yo'qolgan, ammo oyoq-qo'l kuchi hamda tebranish va bo'g'im holati sezgisi to'liq saqlangan. Qo'shimcha ravishda o'ngda Horner sindromi, disfagiya/xirillash, bosh aylanishi va o'ngda ataksiya bor. O'choq qayerda?

options.en: Right lateral medulla (plate U3) — right PICA or vertebral artery occlusion (Wallenberg syndrome)
options.uz: O'ng lateral medulla (U3) — o'ng PICA yoki umurtqa arteriyasi infarkti (Wallenberg)

options.en: Left paramedian medulla (plate U3) — left anterior spinal artery occlusion (Dejerine syndrome)
options.uz: Chap paramedian uzunchoq miya (U3 plastinkasi) — chap oldingi spinal arteriya infarkti (Dejerine)

options.en: Right lateral pontomedullary junction (plate U4) — right AICA occlusion (lateral pontine syndrome)
options.uz: O'ng lateral ko'prik-medulla chegarasi (U4 plastinkasi) — o'ng AICA infarkti (lateral pontin sindrom)

options.en: Right ventral midbrain crus cerebri (plate O2) — right PCA perforator occlusion (Weber syndrome)
options.uz: O'ng ventral o'rta miya oyoqchasi (O2 plastinkasi) — o'ng PCA tarmog'i infarkti (Weber sindromi)

why.en: On plate U3, a right lateral medullary (Wallenberg) infarct hits the right spinothalamic tract (already crossed from left body → left body pain/temp loss), right spinal trigeminal tract and nucleus (uncrossed from right face → right face pain/temp loss), right nucleus ambiguus (dysphagia, hoarseness, absent right gag), right vestibular nuclei (vertigo/nystagmus), right inferior cerebellar peduncle (right limb ataxia), and right descending hypothalamospinal fibres (right Horner), while sparing the medial pyramid and medial lemniscus.
why.uz: U3 plastinkasidagi o'ng lateral uzunchoq miya infarkti (Wallenberg sindromi) o'ng spinotalamik traktni (chap tanadan og'riq/harorat), o'ng spinal trigeminal trakt/yadroni (o'ng yuzdan og'riq/harorat), o'ng ikki ma'noli yadroni (disfagiya va ovoz xirillashi), o'ng vestibulyar yadrolarni (bosh aylanishi), o'ng pastki miyacha oyoqchasini (o'ng ataksiya) va tushuvchi simpatik tolalarni (o'ng Horner) zararlaydi; medialdagi piramida va medial lemnisk esa saqlanib qoladi.

q.en: A 67-year-old man presents with right spastic hemiparesis of the arm and leg (sparing the face), right loss of vibration, fine touch, and joint position sense, and deviation of the protruded tongue to the left, while pain and temperature sensation are completely normal on both the face and body. Which territory is infarcted?
q.uz: 67 yoshli bemorda yuz saqlangan holda o'ng qo'l va oyoqning spastik gemiparezi, o'ng qo'l va oyoqda tebranish hamda bo'g'im holati sezgisining yo'qolishi va til chiqarilganda chap tomonga og'ishi aniqlandi; yuz va tanada og'riq hamda harorat sezgisi mutlaqo normal. Qaysi sohada infarkt yuz bergan?

options.en: Left paramedian medulla (plate U3) — anterior spinal artery occlusion (Dejerine syndrome)
options.uz: Chap paramedian uzunchoq miya (U3) — oldingi spinal arteriya infarkti (Dejerine sindromi)

options.en: Left lateral medulla (plate U3) — posterior inferior cerebellar artery occlusion (Wallenberg)
options.uz: Chap lateral uzunchoq miya (U3) — orqa pastki miyacha arteriyasi infarkti (Wallenberg)

options.en: Left posterior limb of internal capsule (plate B5) — lenticulostriate artery lacunar infarct
options.uz: Chap ichki kapsula orqa oyog'i (B5) — lentikulostriat arteriyaning lakunar infarkti

options.en: Right cervical spinal cord hemisection (below plate U1) — ipsilateral Brown-Séquard syndrome
options.uz: O'ng bo'yin orqa miyasining yarim kesilishi (U1 dan pastda) — Brown-Séquard sindromi

why.en: On plate U3, a left paramedian (medial) medullary infarct (anterior spinal artery, Dejerine syndrome) hits the left medullary pyramid (above the decussation → right arm and leg spastic hemiparesis sparing the face), left medial lemniscus (already crossed → right body vibration and position loss), and exiting left hypoglossal nerve rootlets (LMN weakness causing the protruded tongue to deviate toward the left lesion), while sparing the lateral spinothalamic tract.
why.uz: U3 plastinkasida chap paramedian uzunchoq miya infarkti (oldingi spinal arteriya, Dejerine sindromi) chap piramidani (yuz saqlangan holda o'ng qo'l-oyoq gemiparezi), chap medial lemniskni (o'ng tomonda tebranish va holat sezgisi yo'qolishi) hamda chap til osti nervi ildizchalarini (til o'choq tomonga, ya'ni chapga og'adi) zararlaydi; lateraldagi spinotalamik trakt esa saqlanadi.

q.en: Isolated right-sided corticospinal weakness without any sensory tract deficit can localize to four unilateral sites on the left: (1) motor cortex, (2) internal capsule, (3) ventral midbrain (crus cerebri), and (4) ventral basis pontis. What accompanying clinical features distinguish these four sites from one another?
q.uz: Sezgi yo'llari butunlay saqlangan holda faqat o'ng tomonlama kortikospinal falajlik chap tomondagi to'rtta darajaga mos kelishi mumkin: (1) harakat po'stlog'i, (2) ichki kapsula, (3) ventral o'rta miya (oyoqcha) va (4) ko'prik asosi. Ushbu to'rtta joyni bir-biridan qaysi qo'shimcha klinik belgilar ajratib beradi?

options.en: Cortex: unequal leg vs face/arm + aphasia; capsule: equal pure motor; midbrain: left CN III palsy; pons: ataxia/dysarthria or left CN VI/VII palsy
options.uz: Po'stloq: notekis falaj + afaziya; kapsula: teng sof harakat; o'rta miya: chap III falaji; ko'prik: ataktik gemiparez yoki chap VI/VII falaji

options.en: Cortex: equal face–arm–leg weakness; capsule: Broca aphasia + gaze deviation; midbrain: left CN XII palsy; pons: left CN III palsy with blown pupil
options.uz: Po'stloq: yuz–qo'l–oyoq teng falaji; kapsula: Broka afaziyasi; o'rta miya: chap XII falaji; ko'prik: qorachiq kengayishi bilan chap III falaji

options.en: Cortex: ipsilateral Horner syndrome; capsule: contralateral homonymous hemianopia; midbrain: sensorineural deafness; pons: vertical up-gaze palsy
options.uz: Po'stloq: o'sha tomonda Horner sindromi; kapsula: gomonom gemianopiya; o'rta miya: bir tomonlama karlik; ko'prik: yuqoriga qarash falaji

options.en: Cortex: pure lower-face sparing; capsule: ipsilateral limb ataxia only; midbrain: bilateral palatal tremor; pons: contralateral sensory extinction
options.uz: Po'stloq: pastki yuz saqlanishi; kapsula: faqat o'sha tomon ataksiyasi; o'rta miya: tanglay tremori; ko'prik: qarama-qarshi sezgi so'nishi

why.en: Isolated contralateral corticospinal weakness requires accompanying cortical or cranial-nerve signs to localize the level: cortical strokes split face/arm (left MCA + aphasia) from leg (ACA); capsular lacunes produce equal face–arm–leg pure motor hemiparesis without cortical or cranial-nerve signs; ventral midbrain infarcts add ipsilateral CN III palsy (Weber syndrome); and ventral pontine infarcts add pontocerebellar ataxia/dysarthria (ataxic hemiparesis or dysarthria–clumsy hand) or ipsilateral CN VI/VII palsy (Millard–Gubler).
why.uz: Faqat qarama-qarshi kortikospinal zaiflikning o'zi bilan aniq darajani topish uchun qo'shimcha belgilar hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega: po'stloqda — afaziya va qo'l/oyoq farqi (ACA da oyoq ustun, chap MCA da yuz+qo'l va afaziya); ichki kapsulada — kalla nervi va po'stloq belgilarisiz teng sof harakat lakunasi; ventral o'rta miyada — o'sha tomonda III nerv falaji (Weber); ko'prik asosida — ataktik gemiparez / dizartriya–noqulay qo'l yoki o'sha tomonda VI/VII falaji (Millard–Gubler).

q.en: Six months after a large left internal capsule infarct (plate B5), follow-up brain MRI shows T2 hyperintensity and asymmetric shrinkage down the middle three-fifths of the left crus cerebri (plate O2), the left basis pontis (plate K2), and the left medullary pyramid (plate U3). What is this process, and how is diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) of this tract at 1–2 weeks post-stroke used clinically?
q.uz: Chap ichki kapsulaning yirik infarktidan (B5 plastinkasi) olti oy o'tgach o'tkazilgan MRTda chap miya oyoqchasining o'rta qismi (O2), chap ko'prik asosi (K2) va chap uzunchoq miya piramidasi (U3) bo'ylab T2 giperintensivlik hamda kichrayish (atrofiya) aniqlandi. Bu jarayon nima deb ataladi va insultdan 1–2 hafta keyin ushbu traktning DTI ko'rsatkichi klinikada nimani bashorat qiladi?

options.en: Wallerian degeneration of the corticospinal tract; early posterior-limb fractional anisotropy (FA) asymmetry on DTI predicts upper-limb motor recovery
options.uz: Kortikospinal yo'lning Waller degeneratsiyasi; ichki kapsula orqa oyog'idagi erta DTI FA asimmetriyasi qo'l tiklanishini bashorat qiladi

options.en: Hypertrophic olivary degeneration of the Guillain–Mollaret triangle; early brainstem diffusivity predicts delayed palatal myoclonus and ocular tremor
options.uz: Guillain–Mollaret uchburchagida gipertrofik zaytun degeneratsiyasi; erta miya ustuni diffuziyasi kechikkan tanglay mioklonusi va ko'z tremorini bashorat qiladi

options.en: Retrograde trans-synaptic degeneration of the dorsal column nuclei; early lemniscal FA asymmetry predicts recovery of discriminative hand stereognosis
options.uz: Orqa ustun yadrolarining retrograd transsinaptik degeneratsiyasi; erta lemnisk FA asimmetriyasi kaftdagi farqlovchi stereognoz tiklanishini bashorat qiladi

options.en: Secondary demyelinating plaque extension along the basis pontis; early axial diffusivity drop predicts response to high-dose intravenous corticosteroids
options.uz: Ko'prik asosi bo'ylab ikkilamchi demiyelinizatsiya o'chog'i kengayishi; erta aksial diffuziya pasayishi kortikosteroid puls-terapiyasiga javobni bashorat qiladi

why.en: When upper motor neuron axons are transected in the internal capsule (plate B5), their distal segments undergo anterograde Wallerian degeneration down the ipsilateral crus cerebri, basis pontis, and medullary pyramid, producing T2 hyperintensity and atrophy on follow-up MRI. Early loss of fractional anisotropy (FA) along the posterior limb corticospinal fibres at 1–2 weeks post-stroke quantifies tract integrity and, combined with TMS motor evoked potentials (PREP2 algorithm), predicts upper-limb motor recovery.
why.uz: Ichki kapsula (B5 plastinkasi) insultidan so'ng uzilgan aksonlarning pastki davomi o'sha tomondagi miya oyoqchasi, ko'prik asosi va piramida bo'ylab anterograd Waller degeneratsiyasiga uchraydi (MRTda T2 signal kuchayishi va oyoqcha kichrayishi). Insultdan 1–2 hafta o'tib DTI da ichki kapsula orqa oyog'i fraksion anizotropiyasi (FA) pasayishi trakt butunligini baholab, TMS motor javoblari (PREP2 algoritmi) bilan birga qo'l harakati tiklanishini bashorat qiladi.
